formula: ewm(span=5) of (sum(plus_dm,20) - sum(minus_dm,20)) / sum(true_range,20), where plus_dm and minus_dm are directional movement components
code:
def factor_directional_movement_persistence(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    n = 20
    high = df_copy["high"]
    low = df_copy["low"]
    close = df_copy["close"]
    prev_high = high.shift(1)
    prev_low = low.shift(1)
    prev_close = close.shift(1)
    up_move = high - prev_high
    down_move = prev_low - low
    plus_dm = up_move.where((up_move > down_move) & (up_move > 0), 0.0)
    minus_dm = down_move.where((down_move > up_move) & (down_move > 0), 0.0)
    tr1 = high - low
    tr2 = (high - prev_close).abs()
    tr3 = (low - prev_close).abs()
    true_range = pd.concat([tr1, tr2, tr3], axis=1).max(axis=1)
    plus_dm_sum = plus_dm.rolling(n, min_periods=n).sum()
    minus_dm_sum = minus_dm.rolling(n, min_periods=n).sum()
    true_range_sum = true_range.rolling(n, min_periods=n).sum()
    dx = (plus_dm_sum - minus_dm_sum) / true_range_sum.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    dx = dx.ewm(span=5, min_periods=1).mean()
    df_copy["factor_directional_movement_persistence"] = dx
    return df_copy["factor_directional_movement_persistence"]
description: Uses directional movement (higher highs vs lower lows) accumulated over 20 days, normalized by true range, then exponentially smoothed (span=5). This measures whether persistent directional pressure is upward or downward, isolating sustained trend from noise. The smoothing reduces turnover and supports persistent Top10% membership after neutralization.
